slots_and_copies.name: slot_0_copy_b

checksums.name: payload_sum16_copy_a
checksums.formula_detail: stored_u16le = (sum of unsigned bytes over covered range) mod 65536; s16 accumulator in FUN_0801fffc, no seed/complement/CRC. Header (status+magic) excluded: computed from RAM payload before magic is written to SRAM.

checksums.name: payload_sum16_copy_b
checksums.formula_detail: Same single FUN_0801fffc value as copy A, stored by FUN_08005e18. Covered range is copy B payload [0x3ff0,0x7ffe) as summed from RAM; on-disk naive sum is 0x116d because copy A checksum bytes at 0x401e-0x401f sit inside copy B's window (delta 0x3f = 0x2e+0x11). RAM-view computed value (overlap bytes = pristine payload 0x00,0x00) is 0x112e.

open_questions: Bodies of 0x08005dd8, 0x08005e34, 0x08005e5c, 0x08005c3c, 0x08005c64, 0x08005b08, 0x08005be4, 0x08020310 are absent from the 174-function decompilation: which validator maps to copy A vs B, which loader state 2/3 selects, and whether loaders cross-compare copies are unknown.

All RAM pointer literals (_DAT_0800xxxx) are unresolved in this Ghidra export, so no field can be bound to a concrete EWRAM/IWRAM address and FUN_08005ba4/0x08005bc4 destinations/lengths and FUN_0801fffc count constant cannot be read directly.

Only one populated .sav sample exists (the other is blank 0xFF), so all payload field semantics (index array, 40xu16 list, 0x01f4 counter, flags) are hypotheses awaiting a second gameplay-different snapshot or RAM tracing.

No gameplay save writer beyond the FUN_08005c98 format path was captured; routine progress saving likely reuses the FUN_08005ba4/0x08005bc4 + checksum tail via unrecovered jumptable callers, unverified.
states/ contains 0 paired save states, so every fuzzing prediction in section 6 is unexecuted and requires an emulator cold-load harness.
Whether the loader sums copy B raw (getting 0x116d on this file) or from the pristine payload (0x112e) is discriminated by fuzz tests F3/F4/F7 but not yet observed.
